verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an API, MCP server, webhooks, and alert grouping/deduplication, but none of it describes bulk-edit, batch-update, or multi-item operations (e.g., bulk closing incidents, bulk updating follow-ups, batch API endpoints) that an AI-native user could invoke across many items at once. Alert grouping merely aggregates related alerts for single triage, not user-driven bulk actions.
